column1: # bmc_names.csv - the BMC names the BRIDGE web app offers (one per line
# Only people with full_access in app_access.yaml may type a BMC name that is not here;
# everyone else picks from this list (or from a BMC folder that already exists).
# A name is a folder name: letters
# Lines starting with # are ignored. Re-upload the folder; the app follows within 5 minutes.
